Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 specified card for the conditions of this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that use a card.
Card Q&A.q: There are 2 copies of this card in the battle area.Can I activate both of their [Main] effects and use one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?
